about: Answers checked against the S5 2025-2026 lectures (October 2026). Each question lists, per option, tick / no / unsure and the basis: the lecture (title and slide), an official key on a copy of the same question, or textbook medicine. Unsure options were left as the key had them. The build shows the "Checked against lecture" label only when every ticked option is confirmed (label: true). Nothing here is shown on the site: it is for the maintainer.
